Formal Assessment Activity 2 (from CAPS): Listening and speaking - discussions, sequence of instructions, detail and cause and effect in stories, role play; Phonics - onset and rime in complex patterns, vowel digraphs and diphthongs, word building, sound families; Reading - higher-order questions, simple tables, fluency and expression, independent reading of short fiction and poems; Handwriting - joined-script letters and short words; Writing - topic discussion, drafts and publishes own story with a title, punctuation, pronouns, reads own writing to a partner
notes: Built from the CAPS Grades R-3 Home Language document (Grade 2 Term 3 requirements, pp. 92-97) because the DBE site serves the English FAL file under the HL Term 3 label; CAPS gives term-level content only, so weeks are not split into 2-week cycles
